svg.title: System architecture — output-stationary matrix multiplication
svg.desc: The systolic_top host write ports load two input_skew_buffer instances only while busy is low. A storage and row skew and B storage and column skew feed the N by N systolic_array. Each PE retains its result. The output_buffer captures all accumulators and serves the host read port. Above the datapath, sa_controller accepts start, returns busy, done and cycle_count, and drives the listed control signals.
